recipes.intent: Fire a spawned prefab from an item weapon.
knownLimitations: Requires projectile prefab with compatible rigidbody/collision setup.

recipes.intent: Use a weapon fire event to raycast and modify or demolish voxels.
knownLimitations: Voxel target discovery depends on game-side collider/runtime APIs.

recipes.intent: Package a scene or building prefab as a mod scene.
prefabWiring: voxmod_convert_vox_to_prefab when available; otherwise use the existing VoxModTK conversion workflow
knownLimitations: Large scenes may require manual optimization.

recipes.intent: Play sound, VFX, or BGM based on scene, item, or character triggers.
knownLimitations: Sound/VFX keys must exist in game/mod runtime.
